provenance: Documentation-derived examples and synthetic parser cases, prepared 2026-11-18. Not a live HTTP capture or evidence of charged fees.

cases.name: official_clob_example_has_unsupported_exponent
cases.basis: The fd object from the official CLOB market-info documentation example. Exponent 2 does not match the schedule helper's exponent-1 curve.

cases.name: documented_rate_in_clob_shape
cases.basis: Synthetic CLOB payload using the rate and exponent from the official Gamma feeSchedule example. The official client establishes the fd field mapping.

cases.name: current_crypto_coefficient
cases.basis: Synthetic payload using the current published crypto coefficient. Not a captured market response.

cases.name: new_btc_short_coefficient
cases.basis: Synthetic payload using the published BTC 5-minute and 15-minute up/down coefficient at and after the cutoff.

cases.name: legacy_positive_value_is_not_coefficient
cases.basis: Synthetic legacy response. No universal mapping from this field to fd.r is established.

cases.name: legacy_zero_sentinel_is_unknown
cases.basis: Synthetic SDK failure-sentinel case. It does not establish a fee-free market.

cases.name: explicit_zero_curve
cases.basis: Synthetic valid zero coefficient. The curve explicitly supplies a rate, unlike the legacy sentinel.
